name: keyfob
description: Keep API keys and tokens out of agent conversations and hand each command only the secrets it needs.

interface.shortDescription: Keep secrets out of agent conversations
interface.longDescription: Store API keys in the operating-system keystore, block commands that expose them, and inject only the secrets a command needs.
